state.goal: Sell Zenno's AI booking to Hamburg salons. The strongest proof for owners is seeing how many bookings came from AI assistants and other channels.
state.today: AI bookings are logged (source form, agent label guessed from user agent) but no dashboard shows them. Website bookings record nothing about origin: no UTM parameters, no referrer. The admin dashboard has no bookings-by-source view.
state.facts: ChatGPT appends utm_source=chatgpt.com to links it shares; Perplexity, Gemini and Copilot send recognisable referrers. Capturing UTM/referrer on the booking page plus a 'bookings by source' card (AI booked directly / AI referral / Google / social / direct) is about half a day.
state.announcement_status: Drafted, not sent. Once owners switch AI booking on, early bookings without source tracking can never be attributed later.

timing.instructions: Should booking source tracking be built before sending the announcement to salon owners?

criteria.build_before_announcement: Build source tracking and the dashboard card first, then send the announcement, so every early booking is attributed.
criteria.announce_first: Send the announcement now and add tracking afterwards.

dashboard_placement.instructions: Where should owners see booking sources?

criteria.main_dashboard_card: A 'Where your bookings come from' card on the main admin dashboard every owner opens.
criteria.ai_booking_page_only: Only on the AI booking page.
criteria.both: The card on the main dashboard plus an AI-only breakdown on the AI booking page.
